# Skeleton: isolation review, round 1

Branch `skeleton` at `5acc54d`. Reviewer: isolation-reviewer (opus), 2026-11-13. **Verdict: BLOCKED** (4 blocking, 9 follow-up). Nothing on the branch can leak client data today (no client tables yet); the blocking items are gaps in the gates every later port relies on.

Confirmed correct: SQL helpers in `base_0001_baseline.py:49-61` match SETH (`p01_0001_tenancy_core.py:130-141`), not SECURITY DEFINER, fail closed via `NULLIF(...,'')`, plus a stricter `REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA shifde FROM PUBLIC`; `downgrade()` correct; tenant context set with `set_config(..., true)` (transaction-local); `shifde_app` created NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE and not a member of `shifde_owner`; app-path fixtures connect as `shifde_app`; `pg_has_role(..., 'MEMBER')` catches indirect/NOINHERIT membership.

## Blocking (fix before merge)

1. **RLS test accepts any policy, including `USING (true)`** — `backend/tests/schema/test_rls_schema.py:22-62` (lines 104-108, 118-124 even use `USING (true)` as the compliant example). A permissive true policy, alone or OR-ed with the tenant policy, exposes every client's rows and passes. SETH has such policies (`installation_settings`, `permissions`, `p01_0001:367,384`). No WITH CHECK check either. Fix: for every table not in `global_tables.txt`, read `pg_get_expr(polqual)` / `pg_get_expr(polwithcheck)`; require every permissive policy to reference `shifde.current_tenant_id()` (or `current_principal_id()` for principal-owned rows); require WITH CHECK on INSERT/UPDATE/ALL policies; reject constant-true quals; SETH catalog tables go to `global_tables.txt` with reasons. Probe tests: `USING (true)`; permissive true next to a tenant policy; missing WITH CHECK.
2. **RLS test ignores views, materialized views, foreign tables** — `test_rls_schema.py:26` (`relkind IN ('r','p')`). Views run with owner rights and `shifde_owner` has BYPASSRLS (B-108), so a view granted to `shifde_app` returns all clients' rows. Fix: include `relkind IN ('v','m','f')`; fail every `m`/`f` not in the global list; fail every `v` without `security_invoker=true`. Probe tests for a view and a materialized view.
3. **Startup role check misses REPLICATION and CREATEROLE** — `backend/src/shifde/core/dbrole.py:39-59, 88-103`. A REPLICATION role can read all data via base backup / logical decoding; CREATEROLE on PG ≤15 can grant itself `shifde_owner`. Fix: select and refuse `rolreplication`, `rolcreaterole` over the reachable roles (optionally `pg_read_all_stats`, `pg_monitor`); tests beside `test_bypassrls_role_is_refused`; update B-107.
4. **Preset context settings defeat fail-closed; nothing checks** — `dbrole.py:82-84`, `db.py:54-60, 117-124`. `app.platform_admin=on` or `app.tenant_id=<X>` preset via `ALTER ROLE ... SET`, `ALTER DATABASE ... SET`, `PGOPTIONS`, URL `options=-c`, or `postgresql.conf` makes any transaction without a context run as platform admin or client X, and `set_config(...,true)` reverts to the preset. Fix: `check_app_role` refuses unless `current_setting('app.tenant_id'|'app.principal_id'|'app.platform_admin', true)` are NULL/'' on a fresh connection, and refuses any `pg_db_role_setting` row for the role or database setting `app.*`; `Database` gets a pool `checkout` hook asserting the same; test with `ALTER ROLE <throwaway> SET app.platform_admin='on'`.

## Follow-up (record for the owning later unit)

5. Role check runs only in `shifde.main.run()` (`main.py:37-41`), not `create_app` — other entrypoints skip it. Move into `create_app` or `Database.__init__`; worker must run it against its own URL; consider repeating on readiness. (Owner: skeleton fix round if cheap, else `core`/`runtime`.)
6. Pool hygiene (`db.py:54-111`): reset is ROLLBACK only — add `RESET ALL` on check-in or the checkout assertion (#4) and forbid session-level `app.*` sets; savepoint desync when `set_tenant` runs inside `begin_nested()` then rolls back. (Owner: `core`, `tenancy`.)
7. Helpers' search path not pinned (`base_0001_baseline.py:49-54`): fully qualify builtins (`pg_catalog.current_setting`, `::pg_catalog.uuid`); `dbrole` refuses if `session_user` has CREATE on any non-temp schema. (Owner: skeleton fix round.)
8. SECURITY DEFINER functions owned by `shifde_owner` bypass RLS. Add a schema test: every `prosecdef` function in `shifde` on an allowlist with a reason, `search_path` pinned, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted only to `shifde_app`; pin the five base helpers (not definer, `LANGUAGE sql`, body unchanged). (Owner: skeleton fix round or `tenancy`.)
9. TRUNCATE ignores RLS: assert `shifde_app` has no TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/REFERENCES on client tables; require composite `(tenant_id, id)` FKs between client tables; unique constraints on client tables include `tenant_id`. (Owner: schema test, as tables arrive.)
10. Design §5.3: the tenancy port must not OR `is_platform_admin_ctx()` into policies on client-content tables, only platform catalogs. (Owner: `tenancy`.)
11. `EXEMPT` matches `alembic_version` in any schema (`test_rls_schema.py:20,50`) — tighten to `('shifde','alembic_version')`. (Owner: skeleton fix round.)
12. Cross-client tests should assert `current_user = 'shifde_app'` (`conftest.py:228-232`). (Owner: every module.)
13. `dev_db.ensure_roles` does not revoke pre-existing memberships of `shifde_app`; `Settings.effective_migration_url` falls back to the app URL (`settings.py:284-285`) — consider removing. (Owner: skeleton fix round / `core`.)
